id.description: F1, F2, F3... in severity order, highest first.

title.description: At most 12 words: what breaks, no call chain. Heads the report's row and section.

claim.description: At most 30 words: what breaks. Who calls it and when goes in mechanism.

mechanism.description: The path from entry point to wrong outcome, naming the functions and lines traced.

repro.description: Concrete inputs or state -> the wrong result.

read.description: Every source file opened, paths relative to the tree.
